events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Cane Creek Night: Best Decorated Bike
events.description: Streamers, lights, pool noodles, handlebar bouquets: anything goes as long as your bike is still safe to ride. The podium goes to the two best-decorated bikes.

events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Conative MTB Apparel Night: Reverse Handicap
events.description: In a reverse handicap race, everyone chooses a random number at registration. The racers with the lowest number win!

events.title: Dust 'til Dusk Short Track Race Series - Fox Factory Night: Best Costume
events.description: Halloween-week party. Show up in your best costume and race in it safely. The podium goes to the best costumes of the night. Stick around after the race for the raffle.
